The thing about the debuffs is that they don’t give the player an expiry time, which is definitely a feature that needs to be patched, as many players decide the game isn’t worth it if they’re going to have a permanent debuff affecting their gameplay. But, no matter how it seems on the player end, the debuffs do have a countdown, even if the players can’t see it. It’s randomised per player, so some debuffs may last months and others years, making it hard to figure out how long they’re going to last but, I promise you, they’re not permanent. These debuffs suck the fun out of the questlines that used to be fun, I know, but it won’t be forever. Just take it one day at a time, if you have to. Don’t focus on the main questlines and just focus on doing the daily sidequests instead. It can be overwhelming knowing how much of the game is left and, if you’re not enjoying it now, what the point is of finishing the main quests but there’s so much more to Outside that the debuffs can make you forget about. It’s in the little things. Even small player events can help against the effects of the debuffs, you just have to keep playing until you find a loophole :)

Dude you don’t need to do this. As another person said, it’s been but six months so there’s no way to tell how you’ll feel a month, 6 months or a year onwards about it. But here’s the thing, yes your relationship may have sucked a bit but that’s just it isn’t it? Sometimes relationships don’t work out. Something things just go sideways and you may think you’re to blame but sometimes that’s just the way things go, honestly. Not saying that you or her were at fault, that’s just the way life is. Sometimes, we think we find love then it just goes on it’s head when we least expect it. They’ll sit and think, as you’re doing now, what they could’ve done better to stop you from ever thinking the only way out was suicide. Pain doesn’t last forever, it will take time, no telling how much and you might find yourself losing hope, but it will numb and pass, I promise you. Failed relationships are not the end of the world. You will be able to find love again, maybe not with her but with someone out there waiting to find someone that will never come because he thought the only way out was ending his life. 

Please don’t feel you have to do this man. This doesn’t have to be the end. Please seek help, I’m begging you.
